scripts.test: docker build -f ./Dockerfile.test -t bug-module-test ../../../.. && docker run --rm --name bug-module-test-run bug-module-test sh -lc 'if find ./api ./services -type f -name "*.test.js" -print | grep -q . || find ./api ./services -type f -name "*.spec.js" -print | grep -q .; then if [ -f ./jest.config.cjs ]; then npx jest --runInBand --config ./jest.config.cjs; else npx jest --runInBand; fi; else echo "No module tests found, skipping."; fi'
